headline: Public Law 115-310 directs Congress to arrange a posthumous Congressional Gold Medal for former Egyptian President Anwar Sadat, honoring his efforts toward Middle East peace.
what_it_does: The law asks Congress to arrange for a posthumous Congressional Gold Medal to be awarded to Anwar Sadat, recognizing his achievements and efforts to reach comprehensive peace in the Middle East. The medal would be presented to his widow, Jehan Sadat, or her next of kin, and to a representative of the government of Egypt.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 13, 2018, and the summary does not give a separate date for the medal presentation.
